name: a tile click no longer opens the viewer
why: The tile's plain left click is the main way in; without the handler the link opens the 1200 px image in a new tab instead.
grep: a tile opens the viewer at that image

name: stepping does not wrap
why: → on the last image must go to the first, ← on the first to the last.
grep: a tile opens the viewer at that image

name: focus is not returned to the opener on close
why: Closing must hand focus back to the tile (or tab) that opened the viewer, or a keyboard user is stranded at the page top.
grep: a tile opens the viewer at that image

name: page scrolling is not restored on close
why: The viewer locks documentElement overflow; leaving it 'hidden' freezes the page after close.
grep: a tile opens the viewer at that image

name: keys are not stopped from reaching the page
why: Without stopImmediatePropagation the page's own shortcuts (Ctrl+M, ?, /, Shift+Esc) act behind the viewer.

name: the key listener is on document instead of window capture
why: On document capture it runs AFTER listeners registered earlier on document, so page shortcuts still see every key.

name: Tab is not trapped
why: Without the trap, Tab walks focus out of the overlay into the page behind it.

name: Esc from a G grid closes instead of returning to the image
why: A grid entered with G is a mode of the open viewer; only a viewer OPENED in grid closes on Esc.
grep: G opens the grid grouped by first type

name: the tab interceptor is registered on document, not window
why: initNavigationGuard()'s anchor guard is a document-capture listener registered first; a later document listener runs after its leave-page confirm.
grep: a plain click on the "Cover art" tab

name: the tab interceptor also swallows a Ctrl-click
why: Ctrl/Cmd-click must keep opening the cover-art page in a new tab.

name: the viewer ignores the chip filter and steps through every image
why: Opened from a filtered sheet it must step through the tiles shown, not all 16.

name: the large image never replaces the thumbnail
why: Progressive load: the 1200 px image must be swapped in once it has loaded.
grep: the large image replaces the thumbnail

name: a swipe does not step
why: On touch, a horizontal swipe on the stage is the way to step.
